title: Pulse-response analysis of a simple reaction-advection-diffusion equation
summary: We analyze a reaction-advection-diffusion (RAD) equation arising in pulse-response studies of transport and reaction in a narrow reactor tube. A short pulse of gas is injected near one end of the reactor, while unreacted gas and reaction products are detected at the outlet. Particular attention is given to the effect of a constant axial advection velocity as a minimal extension of the standard diffusion model.
